name: Klumgongyn
dialogue: Ah, Agent K. Have you filed your xenodiplomatic paperwork yet? No? Fascinating species.
Varnyr has three moons, Agent. Your coffee has zero. I rest my case.
Tiberian Dynamics Worldwide is a perfectly normal software company. Say it with me.
I have reviewed your planet's reports on the Order of Hades. Deeply rude organization.

choices.label: What's Varnyr like?
reply: Three moons, triple the tides, triple the paperwork. I miss it chronically.
And no, you may not visit. Your species is still on the 'do not touch' list.

choices.label: How do the finances look?
reply: Tiberian Dynamics Worldwide remains a perfectly normal software company with no maritime fleet whatsoever.
Payroll clears on the 1st. The 1st of which moon is an internal matter.

choices.label: Care for a chess match?
reply: Bold. Mei is the only one in this building I refuse a rematch with. But for you, Agent K, I shall be merciful.
Fox and I remain undefeated as doubles. Challenge us and I will show you what a Krondakhyr invasion feels like.

name: Julia Sharpe
dialogue: Agent K. Good. I was starting to think the coffee machine was my only visitor with clearance.
Edmund Vance recruited me with a postcard that read 'You'll know when it's time.' Infuriating man. He was right.
Whatever you're about to ask: yes, the postcards above my desk are coded. No, I won't tell you what they say.

choices.label: You were at MI6. What was your callsign?
reply: Sable. A negotiator's callsign should be something the other side can't quite catch. Keeps them humble.
I handled the people the fire brigade refused to. Then Prague happened, and here I am.

choices.label: Tell me about Prague.
reply: A hostage exchange. Fourteen minutes in I realized we were the bait, not the buyers.
So I turned the setup inside out and handed SERPENT an entire Order of Hades cell instead. Officially logged as 'a routine debrief.'

choices.label: Any advice for me, ma'am?
reply: Two things. Trust your team further than you can see them.
And read the notice board. GARY has been writing things again.

name: Oriana Olivetti
dialogue: If you touch my mate gourd, Agent, I will treat it as a hostile signal intrusion.
Your phone is leaking telemetry like a Cold War submarine. Come see me after lunch.
Operation Runner: my vacation photos became location intelligence. Never let anyone tell you hobbies don't matter.
Boiling water, metal straw, no sugar. Get it wrong again and we continue this conversation in Spanish.

name: Dmitri Zechev
dialogue: The Order of Hades sent us a phishing campaign this morning. I mailed it back with their own infrastructure inside. Petty? Yes. Satisfying? Also yes.
I taught myself to code at seven, on a machine that booted out of pure spite. Your lab equipment bores me.
That framed screenshot is my first indictment. My first exposé helped take down a corrupt government. I was very proud.
Rule one of red team: if you're polite to the firewall, you deserve to be logged.

name: Mei Huang
dialogue: You have the posture of someone withholding something, Agent K. Sit down before I profile you out loud.
Twelve languages, and the only one that matters here is Volrac glyph script. MI6 called my thesis 'academic curiosity.' It's the reason this building still stands.
Klumgongyn says my thesis is dangerous. It's only dangerous to people in cults. Statistically, you're fine. Probably.
Chess on Thursday? Careful. I'm the only person in this HQ he won't give a rematch.

name: Isabella Moreno
dialogue: Four centuries of archives, Agent. The Order of Hades was hiding in plain sight the whole time. In triplicate, usually.
My grandmother's documents found them before any satellite did. Respect the paper trail.
The photos on my desk are my parents. Everything I do in this building is for them.
An artifact is genuine if the paperwork survives. The Order kept excellent records. That was their mistake.

name: Fox Meyer
dialogue: I really do want to believe, Agent K. It's on my coffee mug, my file, and my entire career.
The TFBI says I 'separated.' That's the single paper record I left. Everything else, I erased myself.
2015, Nevada: officially 'weather balloon debris.' I logged the Krondakhyr telemetry before it self-destructed. Balloons don't scream in forty frequencies.
Chess night, first Friday of the month. Klumgongyn and I are undefeated. It's the only statistic I care about.

name: James Brown
dialogue: Shaken, not stirred, Agent K. If you have to ask why, you're not ready for the tuxedo missions.
Five years undercover in Halston & Grey. An auction house. An Order of Hades front. I got very good at nodding at vases.
Poker night: I win through statistics, not cheating. The statistics of other people's tells, specifically.
Julia called, I left MI6. Some costs you only pay once. A decade of forged relationships, one real marriage. I don't recommend the write-up.

name: Cassandra Laurent
dialogue: Power leaks, Agent K. My job is knowing where, in fifteen languages.
Brussels ignored my dossier for six years while it quietly killed anomaly legislation in three parliaments. SERPENT acted in a month.
I can end an argument with Klumgongyn in under a minute. The trick is to be more polite than he is. It's devastating.
Half my contact book owes me unspecified favors. The other half owes me specified ones. Both halves are useful.

name: Gabriel Adams
dialogue: BTRU eats after everyone else, Agent. That includes you, on days the coffee machine is empty.
Afghanistan, second deployment. Six objects in that crash zone that belonged to nothing human. Seven days holding it. Three people at the debrief. I've been here since.
I don't know anything about a boxing gym in Baltimore. Ask me again and I still won't.
SERPENT is not a hit squad. But if a firefight starts, stand behind me and don't apologize.

name: Mikko Häyhä
dialogue: Eastern Finland. The region produces silence, patience, and marksmen. In that order.
Eleven days at minus forty in Svalbard, guarding a 'meteor impact site' that was no meteor. When SERPENT offered me a job on the spot, it was the warmest thing that happened all month.
My rifle's name is Aila. After my grandmother. Whether that was a compliment is between the three of us.
Am I related to a certain legendary Winter War sniper? I neither confirm nor deny, Agent. But I appreciate the question.

name: Amir Hussaini
dialogue: My father taught me how buildings stand up. Then he taught me all the interesting ways they change their mind.
By the time the briefing started, I had the bazaar's blasting requirements mapped from memory. People looked at me strangely. People looked at the detonators strangely too.
Liam has patched me up after more than one 'experiment.' He calls me mostly reliable. From him, that's a love letter.
Everything is an explosive if you respect it enough, Agent K.

name: Liam Irwin
dialogue: Three weeks alone in jungle, injured, with a broken radio. The search teams wrote me off. I call that a long weekend.
Snakebite, gunshot, or Amir's experiments. I've treated all three. At least the snake apologized.
Fox and Klumgongyn are unbeaten at chess doubles. It has ended at least one of my friendships. I remain young. I remain hopeful.
Nature settles all arguments, Agent. Our job is making sure the Order of Hades never gets a rematch.
